statement: A-narrow is frozen here, BEFORE the colleague-written R2 set is touched. The R2 run is one shot; this freeze is what makes its numbers attributable to this code.

a_narrow.rule: decline only on leak / fluid-level / consumption-wear evidence; smoke colour, mechanical noise and smell ADVISE alongside the ranked codes; any electronic evidence overrides a decline entirely
a_narrow.derived_from: the Phase 11.1 recommendation: all 6 of the broad rule's false declines came from the three advisory categories, and all 13 of its correct declines from the three decline categories
a_narrow.fix_during_development: weather phrases ('damp morning', 'wet road') are removed before the mechanical scan - weather is not a fluid leak. Found on a synthetic probe, not on any gold row.

no_regression_before_freezing.DEV: symptom hit@1 0.583 / MRR 0.7111, groups 3/3, oos 6/6, in-scope 28/28 - identical to production

round1_post_hoc.note: POST-HOC: the Round-1 set was spent in Phase 10.6
round1_post_hoc.broad_A: 13/19 declined, 6 false declines on 41 symptom rows
round1_post_hoc.A_narrow: 7/19 declined, 1 false decline (Q19), 6 no_dtc rows get advisory + codes
